description: Ministry of Industrial Export and Investment Promotion - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2178/21 of 03.06.2020 (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a regulatory order under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, specifically rescinding a CESS amount on cement products. It focuses on legal/regulatory matters (amending existing regulations through statutory instruments) rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories. The mention of ministers serves to establish authority for the regulatory action but does not constitute the main focus of the document.
